title: FalconEvent payload: ares.market_status.session_state (v1)
description: Typed payload schema for registered FALCON event family 'ares.market_status.session_state'. PID-06 Stage 2A/2B contract reconciliation: replaces the speculative, pre-discovery 5-value session-lifecycle model (session_id/market_id/session_state, never produced by any real ARES code) with ARES's real, authoritative market_state observation (OPEN|CLOSED|UNKNOWN) plus its orthogonal reason_code.
